name: SAI Advanced Power Solutions
old_description: Introducing Profusion™ - a revolutionary all-in-one PDU platform with one of the best industry lead times, quality, and performance. It features a sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and power distribution cabinet with advanced metering and monitoring, accessible locally and remotely.
about:
SAI Advanced Power Solutions is headquartered in Franklin Park, Illinois, with additional campuses in St. Charles and a distribution center in Carol Stream. The company operates as an end-to-end manufacturer of advanced power distribution solutions, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and builds low-voltage switchgear (UL 1558, UL 891), medium-voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, DC switchgear, and custom power distribution units (PDUs). Its product portfolio includes the Profusion™ all-in-one PDU platform with sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and integrated metering, as well as the EVention™ platform for EV charging infrastructure compliant with BABA standards. SAI also provides engineering, design, system optimization, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and power quality monitoring services. A new production center, three times the size of its previous facility, supports both custom and high-volume manufacturing.

SAI serves customers in telecommunications, renewable energy integration, hydrogen energy generation, battery energy storage systems, and energy consulting. Its market-focused business units target mission-critical facilities, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), commercial/industrial/government accounts, emerging markets, and after-market support.

The company emphasizes engineering precision combined with manufacturing capability, citing one of the industry's best lead times, a patented product portfolio, and a Teaming for Customer Success (TCS) initiative that dedicates specialists to exceed customer expectations.
